newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Parana State power utility Copel.
-- However, it said Copel's shares are not one of its four top picks in the sector. It said it prefers Cemig.

-- Although the privatization of either Cemig or Copel is not expected in the short and medium terms, Cemig is likely to benefit strategically and operationally from the sale of a voting stake to a foreign partner, analyst Rosana Aldworth said in a report.
-- Cemig is due to sell a 33 percent stake in coming months.

-- Aldworth's report also said Copel plans to launch $100 million in Level Three ADRs in the first half of 1997. It said Parana State government, Copel's main shareholder, is not expected to subscribe for the shares, increasing float and share liquidity.
-- But the deal "implies dillution for shareholders and a share overhang," it said.
-- The report comes ahead of today's auction of 8.4 billion Copel voting shares by BNDES Participacoes, the investment wing of the National Development Bank.
-- The shares, accounting for 5.75 percent of the voting capital and 3.45 percent of the total capital, will be sold for a minimum price of 10.51 reais each.
-- The auction is to take place late this afternoon on the Parana Stock Exchange.
